summary: Tactile Systems Technology Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an exclusive distribution agreement with ElastiMed, Inc. for the MyoSleeve device, a non-pneumatic compression product for lower leg chronic swelling, targeting VA and DoD patients. The registrant made a $3 million upfront payment and committed to minimum purchase obligations and marketing support. This is a routine product distribution arrangement, not a structural corporate event. No special-situation classification applies.
